Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

else adverb

also anything else, something else, someone else, what else, everyone else, or else, somewhere else, elsewhere, what else can I do for you?, what else do you do?, what else?, no one else, nobody else

classical

Ter. Eun. 191: numquid vīs aliud?
Tac. Dial. 29.3: quī domī quicquam aliud loquātur
Traupman 309, 406

alius, alia, aliud

adjective and pronoun: quid aliud? what else?; nēmō alius, nobody else

else, other

Latin has no separate word: “someone else” is alius, “something else” aliud. Numquid vīs aliud?, “Anything else?”, is how one takes leave in comedy (Ter. Eun. 191, Ph. 151).

Other words

  • praetereā — besides, else (in addition)

    adverb: quid praetereā? what else? · also used · classical · Cic. de Or. 1.60: nihilne vōbīs in mentem venit, quod praetereā Crassō requīrātis? (Lewis & Short)

  • cēterī, cēterae, cētera — everyone else, the rest, the others

    adjective, mostly plural · also used · classical

  • alibī — elsewhere, somewhere else

    adverb; “to somewhere else” is aliō, “from somewhere else” aliunde · also used · classical · Tac. Germ. 19.5: quam alibī bonae lēgēs; Traupman 309

  • sīn aliter — or else, but if not, otherwise

    also used · classical · Cic. Att. 1.2.1: sīn aliter acciderit, hūmāniter ferēmus; Ter. Ph. 116: sīn aliter, negat

Examples

  • In hoc biduum, Thāis, valē. — Mī Phaedria, et tū; numquid vīs aliud?

    Goodbye for these two days, Thais. — Phaedria dear, you too; anything else?Ter. Eun. 190–191

  • quotum quemque inveniēs quī domī quicquam aliud loquātur?

    how many will you find who talk about anything else at home?Tac. Dial. 29.3

  • sīn aliter acciderit, hūmāniter ferēmus

    if it turns out otherwise, we shall take it like sensible peopleCic. Att. 1.2.1

  • quid est quod tibi mea ars efficere hoc possit amplius?

    what more can my skill do for you than this?Ter. And. 1.1.4 (Lewis & Short s.v. amplus)

  • Quid est quod tibi efficere possum amplius?

    What else can I do for you?Traupman 111

  • Quid aliud facis?

    What else do you do?Traupman 40

  • Quid amplius facis?

    What else do you do?Traupman 40

  • Quid amplius?

    What else?Traupman 25

  • quīvīs alius

    anyone elseTraupman 309

  • nēmō alius

    no one elseTraupman 309

  • Quis alter est dignior homō?

    Who else is more deserving?Traupman 309
